requiredFindings.title: Make the post-adapter attribute fence recognize Rust token separation
requiredFindings.detail: The attribute fence inspects only trimmed lines beginning with contiguous `#[`, but Rust permits whitespace or comments between the `#` and `[` tokens. Valid unapproved forms such as `# [path = "bridge.rs"]` and `#/**/[some_attribute]` are therefore skipped; absent the other literal sentinels, the predicate admits the source and removes the adapter's `finalize`. This leaves the generated or unscanned bridge route open despite the r2 disposition. Reject every post-adapter attribute token sequence except the exact permitted built-ins regardless of token-separating whitespace/comments, and add corresponding negative controls with fresh affected evidence.
